title: Service Assistant
description:
What To Expect
Tesla Motors is looking for a Service Assistant to work on one of the most progressive vehicles in the world. We are seeking professional customer service experience and excellent oral and written communication skills. If you are interested in contributing to an amazing customer experience, we want you to join our service team. We are looking for self-motivated team players with a positive attitude! We seek individuals who value customer satisfaction. The Service Assistant is a key contributor in the Tesla experience.

What You'll Do

Vehicle cleaning (wash and minor detailing) Deliver vehicles between production, service and sales operations Parts runner - expedite parts requirements as directed from Parts Operations Clean shop and Parts Operations Truck & Trailer service and maintenance Miscellaneous jobs as required 


What You'll Bring

Great work ethic & team player Ability to lift 50 - 60 pounds Valid drivers license is required

title: Lead Warehouse Associate, Energy
description:
What To Expect
The Lead Warehouse Associate is part of Tesla’s Energy Operations team. As a leader at Tesla, the Lead Warehouse Associate will continuously model to others Tesla standards and responsibilities, including policy compliance, quality standards, safety, and efficiency goals. The ideal candidate will thrive in a high-volume and fast-paced environment, be able to communicate effectively, and possess strong leadership abilities and soft skills. They will be a self-starter, able to adapt and prioritize in a rapidly growing and changing environment, and responsible for all aspects of the warehouse, including the training and development of Warehouse Associates

What You'll Do

Properly maintain warehouse organization to ensure all materials are inventoried, accessible, countable, and identifiable. Develop and adopt procedures and make suggestions regarding procedures, standards, and equipment to facilitate more safe and efficient workMaintain inventory records to ensure installation crews have material to meet their daily goals and provide employees with the necessary tools, proper training, and corrective directionReview and document inventory count to ensure accuracy within the warehouseCoordinate with other warehouses to mitigate shortages or surplusComplete auditable records: packing slips, pick lists, Job Closeout paperworkDeliver materials to job sites when needed. Complete all required safety trainings, follow safety policies, and always demonstrate proper safety protocols. Additional duties, as necessary


What You'll Bring

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other resource planning softwareAbility to perform repetitive duties, including lifting, bending, and standing for long periods of time. Must be able to handle materials weighing up to 50 lbsExcellent written and verbal communication skillsAbility to work well with others in a collaborative team environment along with excellent attendance is crucial for the team to achieve success. Open availability to work during weekends, and holidaysValid driver's license required50% of travel requiredPreferred Qualifications: Previous Warehouse experience plus a Forklift certification

title: Warehouse Associate
description:
What To Expect
We are currently hiring a skilled Material Handler for our Parts Distribution Warehouse in Queretaro, Mexico to support our Service Operations. This individual will be held responsible for understanding and adhering to all warehouse processes, inventory accuracy improvements, and general operational checks and balances of our global parts distribution operations.

What You'll Do

Materials from designated areas to/from production floor using forklift and/or other transport conveyance methodsPrepares outgoing materials using a variety of methods and equipment, including, but not limited to, scanning, labeling, wrapping/packaging etc.Completes required paperwork to accompany outgoing materials such as Inter-company Bills of LadingUses systems technology to input and retrieve inventory and parts data & assesses material needs for assigned Production area(s) throughout the shift and pulls materials using an information system to support the production scheduleGeneral housekeeping of work area & other duties as assigned


What You'll Bring

Ability to frequently and repetitively bend, lift and reach to move and install parts of varying size and weight overhead, frequently and repetitively lift items up to 50 lbs. and repetitively push and pull items up to 75 lbs.Good communication skills, ability to multitask and prioritize work in order to successfully accomplish job dutiesForklift experience required and periodic re-certification required User-level knowledge of Microsoft Office SuitePrior experience in a Manufacturing environment preferred, plus valid driver's license

title: Warehouse Infrastructure Technician
description:
What To Expect
The Warehouse Infrastructure Technician is a role for someone experienced in warehouse facilities, who must be extremely thorough with tasks, possesses outstanding communication skills and can demonstrate diligence and devotion with task and project completion. Knowledge of Recycling, Safety Compliance, and Emergency Response processes. Ability to continuously find ways to improve processes for better efficiency and cost initiatives. This individual must be able to perform manual tasks such as furniture assembly, pallet rack repair, cardboard baling, Waste Removal, forklift operation and moving of boxes/large items throughout the facility.

What You'll Do

Day to Day facility maintenance of office and warehouse spaces, ensuring a safe, clean, efficient, and pleasant workplace environment is in place. Includes janitorial cleaning/maintenance of restrooms and breakrooms Perform basic plumbing and electrical repairs, equipment assembly/repair Liaise with Repair and Maintenance vendors to procure parts, materials, and supplies upon request MHE Fleet Support – Communicate all repair needs in a timely manner via in-house automated ticketing system. Perform minor repairs Coordinate the movement of all recyclable materials to suitable external containers for collection, attempting to keep all non-recyclable material out of external recycle containers, ensuring all containers and equipment remain in good working condition and are operated in a safe manner. Employee shall keep updated collection routes and schedules Support rapid, orderly, and complete evacuation of premises during emergencies 


What You'll Bring

3+ years of relevant experience in a warehouse setting Able to lift and/or carry or push up to 50lbs. Excellent listening skills, organizational skills, & strong communication skills with leaders & Managers using in house Technology Ability to work in a fast-paced environment under constant changing priorities and demands Ability to work independently on assigned tasks and accept direction on given assignments and proficient in Microsoft Office Suite Ability to communicate via Email/Chat, Manage Fexa, Warp systems Language Requirements: Must be fluent in both Spanish and English, with the ability to communicate effectively with stakeholders in both languages

title: Training Program Specialist
description:
What To Expect
The Service Distribution Team is looking for a highly motivated individual to support training needs across our North American network, with the ability to travel to other sites. This position will be based out of Queretaro, Mexico and will be responsible for coordinating and facilitating new hire training, well as providing ongoing training for existing team members for warehouse processes and safety.

What You'll Do

Work collaboratively with the Tesla onboarding team to ensure a smooth transition into training, including scheduling, logistics, and communicationFacilitate live trainings for new hires, exiting employees, and other training that may require formal training, including material handling equipment and safety topicsDocument and train all levels of Distribution Center staff on operational processes, safety requirements, and policy complianceMonitor training trends and certification gaps through training record retention and analysisCollaborate with Operational Leadership to establish continuous developmental cross-training plans, creating flexible and efficient operational teamsFacilitate in-person New Hire Orientation, preparing new team members to meet operational performance and safety expectationsEnsure the Learning Management System (LMS) is accurate and up-to-date, and track certifications of team members to safely operate material handling equipment


What You'll Bring

Minimum of 2 years working in a Distribution environment (Lead experience preferred), with experience operating a variety of warehouse material handling equipmentVerifiable work experience in a role requiring the inspection, use, and storage of fall protection equipment (minimum 3 years)Qualified to obtain a DC-5 certification and issue DC-3 certifications to othersStrong verbal and written communication skills, fluent in English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate professionally with international partners and work effectively in a fast-paced environmentCompelling presentation skills and ability to facilitate training classes, with empathy and patience for all levels of adult learnersProficient in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and experience with promoting EHS&S, Safety, and standards programsDemonstrates professionalism, including organized, dress, and attitude, with a strong passion for facilitating large groups

title: Vehicle Readiness Supervisor
description:
What To Expect
The Vehicle Readiness Manager is responsible for delivering an exceptional experience to our customers via vehicle quality, developing team members, and managing day-to-day vehicle delivery operations. Our managers must deliver excellent results and achieve goals quarter after quarter, month after month, on all aspects of customers, people, operations, and financials. The ideal candidate has the technical acumen to be able to communicate effectively with internal teams, excellent time management abilities and is passionate about leading change while inspiring teams. This role directly supports Tesla’s mission by ensuring an exceptional and memorable buying experience for our customers.

What You'll Do

Lead the delivery vehicle readiness team consisting of vehicle quality, detail, and service specialists. Actively set individual and team targets for Detailers and Vehicle Movement Specialists and actively train, coach, and develop themAssist in the planning, implementation, and follow up of vehicle prep operational tasks and projects including, but not limited to vehicle movement coordination in vehicle lots and delivery bays, delivery schedule monitoring, vehicle repairs, detailer performance, lot organization and maintenance, and coordinator supportHelp control expenses, including staffing, supplies, vendor management, and services. Work collaboratively with other departments, particularly the Sales, Delivery and Service Departments to enhance customer experienceRepresent Tesla in a professional and responsible manner when communicating with others both inside and outside the company. Monitor daily deliveries, create reporting metrics, and actively review information with your greater store leadership team. Maintain constant focus on improving the Tesla delivery experience and vehicle qualityMeet and Exceed KPI, partner to achieve sales and delivery targets along with P&L requirements for location. Proficient in-Service Operations; strong collaboration with cross-functional store leadershipRecruit, train, and develop management team and employees ensuring all positions are filled in a timely manner. Support, implement and provide follow-up for all training. Continually evaluate the performance of each employee and provide constant feedback to drive results. Ensure all employees adhere to Tesla policies and procedures. Resolve all people and safety issues in a timely and effective manner, collaborating with Human Resources and appropriate teams effectively


What You'll Bring

3+ years of applicable experience with proven track record of meeting or exceeding goals in a service-focused industry; automotive expertise is not requiredStrong and proven experience leading field, technical repair, or manufacturing teams in a fast-paced, technology driven environmentAbility to problem solve, prioritize multiple projects, and adhere to business-critical deadlinesExcellent written and verbal communication skills. Dedicated and ethical approach to Tesla standardsAbility to develop collaborative relationships acting as a well-respected, trusted partner with whom others want to workAbility to work evening hours, weekends, and holidays in a retail environmentValid driver’s license is required

title: Staff Account Manager, Megapack Sales
description:
What To Expect
The “Americas Utility Energy Team” focuses primarily on development of front-of-the-meter battery energy storage (BESS) applications for customers including electric utilities, independent power producers and renewable energy developers. Projects are typically large, utility-scale BESS deployments that provide renewables integration, capacity, or grid services.

This is multi-faceted role where a strong technical knowledge of Tesla’s energy product suite and strong business knowledge of the market for energy storage is expected. The Sales Manager will lead projects from conception through contract execution with support from Tesla’s technical and commercial support organizations. This role will involve a mix of internal and external task management responsibilities. Internally, diverse project teams comprised of engineering, finance, legal and other disciplines will need to be coordinated. Externally, customer relationships are built and managed, contracts are negotiated and closed. Besides a strong work ethic and a team-oriented personality, members of our team display creativity, passion, and a desire to break new ground in a constantly growing technology and market landscape.

What You'll Do

Manage a project pipeline of short, medium, and long-term opportunities spanning multiple states, project types, and marketsLead the sales cycle, including deal origination, project development management, contract negotiation and closing a targeted product volume and/or revenue each year (quota bearing)Manage techno-economic analysis of opportunities- identifying associated risks, optimizing technical and commercial variables, and articulating Tesla’s value versus competitive offeringsProvide reporting to management as and when requiredGenerate quotes and supply customers with high quality, accurate project proposals, often in response to highly complex and formal utility RFPs


What You'll Bring

4-5 years minimum work experience in the renewable energy space and/or power sectorExperience in sales or business development (customer-facing)Working knowledge of battery systems, renewable power, and grid marketsHands-on contract negotiation experience in energy storage or renewablesExperience managing cross-functional projects in fast paced, dynamic settingsStrong analytical/quantitative skills regarding complex price models, storage/renewable project economics, techno-economic optimizations, quantitative risk analysis, etc.Ability to travel periodically


, Tesla
